Looking at the screen, I can see:
- "Wi-Fi" text with a toggle switch next to it
- The toggle appears to be in the off position (based on the description)
- I need to tap on the Wi-Fi toggle to turn it on

The Wi-Fi toggle is located at coordinates [0,337,999,402] according to the tree structure description.
